journal.sentenceEn: In a review published in the journal *Trends in Cognitive Sciences* on February 11th, researchers propose an explanation for why this might be happening: the brains of older adults allocate more space to accumulated knowledge and have more material to navigate when attempting to access memories.
journal.translationZh: 在2月11日发表于《认知科学趋势》期刊的一篇综述中，研究人员对这种现象提出了一种解释：老年人的大脑为积累的知识分配了更多空间，在试图提取记忆时需要处理更多信息。
journal.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第1句

journal.sentenceEn: Now, the Journal of Applied Social Psychology has published a new study exploring the reasons for these effects.
journal.translationZh: 现在，《应用社会心理学杂志》发表了一项新研究，旨在探讨这些影响背后的原因。
journal.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第7句

journal.sentenceEn: Two papers published today in the American Journal of Clinical Nutrition outline the case for and against using the concept of ultra-processed foods to help inform dietary guidelines beyond conventional food classification systems.
journal.translationZh: 今日发表在《美国临床营养学杂志》上的两篇论文，探讨了在传统食品分类系统之外，是否应使用超加工食品概念为膳食指南提供信息的支持与反对观点。
journal.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第1句

journal.sentenceEn: In research published in the journal Science Robotics, a team at Northwestern University said the crab-like robot is 0.5mm wide.
journal.translationZh: 在《科学·机器人学》期刊发表的研究中，西北大学的一个团队表示，这款类似螃蟹的机器人宽度为0.5毫米。
journal.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第2句

journal.sentenceEn: What did the researchers do in their review in the journal Trends in Cognitive Sciences?
journal.translationZh: 研究人员在《认知科学趋势》期刊上的综述中做了什么？

journal.sentenceEn: They are going to publish their research findings in the journal Science Robotics.
journal.translationZh: 他们计划将研究成果发表在《科学·机器人学》期刊上。

judgment.sentenceEn: Participants had to imagine themselves as the closest figure in the video and then make judgments about the conversations and how they felt about their conversation partners.
judgment.translationZh: 参与者需要将自己想象成视频中最亲近的人物，随后对对话内容以及他们对谈话对象的感受做出判断。
judgment.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第4句

judgment.sentenceEn: The illusion of control can also interfere with our best judgment , leading us to overestimate our ability to control events and attain a positive outcome.
judgment.translationZh: 控制错觉还会干扰我们的理性判断，导致我们过高估计自己控制事件并获得积极结果的能力。

judgment.sentenceEn: This singular, fixed sense of self was clouding her judgment and limiting her choices for action.
judgment.translationZh: 这种单一且固化的自我意识正蒙蔽她的判断力，并限制她做出行动选择。

judgment.sentenceEn: It means practicing being fully present in another person's presence and listening to them with complete attention without judgment , while resisting the urge to make the interaction about you.
judgment.translationZh: 这意味着练习全身心地投入到与他人的相处中，全神贯注地倾听对方而无需评判，同时克制住将互动中心转向自己的冲动。
judgment.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第8段，第3句

judgment.sentenceEn: What is the consequence of algorithmic prescription replacing human judgment ?
judgment.translationZh: 算法指令取代人类判断的后果是什么？

judgment.sentenceEn: It focuses our attention on the present moment without making judgments .
judgment.translationZh: 它让我们将注意力集中在当下，而不做任何评判。

judge.sentenceEn: We worry because we suspect—not wrongly—that the world is full of a frightening sort of person ready to judge us ruthlessly and swiftly: a person we can call a snob.
judge.translationZh: 我们感到忧虑，因为我们不无道理地怀疑：世界上充斥着一种可怕的人，他们随时准备对我们进行无情而迅速的评判——我们可以称这种人为势利小人。
judge.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第1句

judge.sentenceEn: If we judge the value of gifts based on their price, this gift may seem worthless, but in a distracted world, it is a precious one.
judge.translationZh: 如果我们以价格来衡量礼物的价值，这份礼物或许显得微不足道；但在一个令人分心的世界里，它却弥足珍贵。
judge.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第9段，第1句

judge.sentenceEn: One of the significant consequences of obsessive filtering is the emerging tendency to treat oneself as an object to be observed and valued, in the same way another person observes and judges from the side.
judge.translationZh: 过度自我审视的一个重要后果是，人们逐渐倾向于将自己视为一个被观察和评价的对象，就像他人从旁观察和评判自己一样。
judge.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第7段，第3句

judge.sentenceEn: This means that how a person judges their security in comparison to their neighbors' has more of an impact on their happiness than their objective standard of living.
judge.translationZh: 这意味着，一个人通过与邻居比较所感知的安全感，比其客观生活水平对幸福感的影响更大。

judge.sentenceEn: How are we all judged according to the passage?
judge.translationZh: 根据文章内容，我们所有人是如何被评判的？

judge.sentenceEn: They judge a person by their occupation.
judge.translationZh: 他们根据职业来判断一个人。

jazz.sentenceEn: Sarcasm and jazz have something surprisingly in common: You know them when you hear them.
jazz.translationZh: 讽刺和爵士乐有着惊人的共同点：一听便知。
jazz.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第1句

jazz.sentenceEn: So as a result, there are fewer listeners of jazz , which is a great shame because it's an incredibly rich genre.
jazz.translationZh: 因此，爵士乐的听众越来越少，这实在令人惋惜，因为爵士乐是一种内容极其丰富的音乐类型。
jazz.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第6段，第4句

jazz.sentenceEn: Indeed, there are many different styles of jazz .
jazz.translationZh: 的确，爵士乐有许多不同的风格。
jazz.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第8段，第2句

jazz.sentenceEn: We have a cafe & library upstairs and a ticket office down the hall, where you can buy tickets to all the major jazz concerts in the city.
jazz.translationZh: 楼上设有咖啡馆和图书馆，走廊尽头有票务办公室，您可以在那里购买本市所有重要爵士乐音乐会的门票。
jazz.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第4段，第4句

jazz.sentenceEn: Why does the author say sarcasm and jazz have something surprisingly in common?
jazz.translationZh: 为什么作者说讽刺和爵士乐有着令人惊讶的共同点？
它赞助大型爵士乐音乐会。

justify.sentenceEn: While the mechanisms behind these associations are not fully understood, Monteiro argues that the existing evidence is sufficient to justify discouraging consumption of ultra-processed foods in dietary recommendations and government policies.
justify.translationZh: 虽然这些关联背后的机制尚未完全明确，但蒙泰罗认为现有证据已足以支持在膳食建议和政府政策中劝阻超加工食品消费。
justify.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第4段，第2句

justify.sentenceEn: Higher prices, called price premiums, can be justified as a way to compensate farmers for providing ecosystem services and avoiding environmental damage or external costs.
justify.translationZh: 被称为溢价的较高价格是合理的，这是对农民提供生态系统服务以及避免环境破坏或外部成本的一种补偿方式。
justify.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第9段，第2句

justify.sentenceEn: We usually start off with the more affordable methods and if everything looks promising, then it will justify trying to build a sleep lab and study sleep across cultures that way.
justify.translationZh: 我们通常从成本较低的方法入手，如果一切看起来有前景，那么就值得尝试建立睡眠实验室，通过这种方式进行跨文化睡眠研究。
justify.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第5段，第3句

justify.sentenceEn: But I have refused to give up on Venus, and over the years my stubborn loyalty has been justified .
justify.translationZh: 但我始终没有放弃金星，多年来，我这份固执的坚持终于有了回报。
justify.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第5段，第1句

justify.sentenceEn: Why does the WHO feel the need to appeal to the economic benefits of improving mental health to justify its recommendations?
justify.translationZh: 为什么世界卫生组织认为有必要诉诸改善心理健康所带来的经济效益来证明其建议的合理性？

justify.sentenceEn: The tuition they charge is not justified by the quality of their service.
justify.translationZh: 他们收取的学费与其提供的服务质量并不相称。

jargon.sentenceEn: A scientist should take communication courses that can teach a person how to identify and eliminate jargon and how to develop effective analogies to explain complex concepts.
jargon.translationZh: 科学家应当参加传播学课程，学习如何识别和去除专业术语，以及如何构建有效的类比来解释复杂概念。
jargon.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第6段，第3句

jargon.sentenceEn: Scientists often use specialized jargon terms while communicating with laymen.
jargon.translationZh: 科学家在与非专业人士交流时，常常使用专业术语。
jargon.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第1句

jargon.sentenceEn: Schulman concedes that the use of jargon is appropriate with scientific audiences.
jargon.translationZh: 舒尔曼承认，在与科学界受众交流时使用专业术语是恰当的。
jargon.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第4段，第3句

jargon.sentenceEn: Even when the terms were defined, readers still felt the same lack of engagement as readers who read jargon that wasn't explained.
jargon.translationZh: 即使这些术语被给出了定义，读者仍然感到与那些阅读未经解释的术语的读者同样缺乏参与感。
jargon.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第6句

jargon.sentenceEn: What do researchers find about people reading scientific articles containing jargon terms?
jargon.translationZh: 研究人员发现人们阅读含有专业术语的科学文章时有什么发现？

jargon.sentenceEn: They feel intimidated by the jargon researchers use to describe their findings.
jargon.translationZh: 他们对研究人员用来描述研究结果的专业术语感到畏惧。

journey.sentenceEn: It's possible, however, that the journey towards wage parity would have stalled either way.
journey.translationZh: 然而，无论如何，实现工资平等的进程都有可能停滞不前。
journey.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第10段，第1句

journey.sentenceEn: Archaeologists don't want artifacts ending up in a private collection instead of taking humanity on a journey of understanding.
journey.translationZh: 考古学家不希望这些文物最终落入私人收藏家手中，而是希望它们能带领人类踏上一段启迪心智的认知之旅。

journey.sentenceEn: They also can provide more seating in public places, so that less-fit residents can rest during their journeys .
journey.translationZh: 城市还可以在公共场所增设更多座椅，这样体能较弱的居民在出行途中可以随时休息。
journey.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第4段，第2句

journey.sentenceEn: He will line up Monday in Antarctica(南极) for the first leg of the World Marathon Challenge—joining 32 other adventure seekers on an unusual journey where participants travel through different time zones and climates to run seven marathons on seven continents in seven days.
journey.translationZh: 周一，他将在南极站到起跑线前，参加世界马拉松挑战赛的第一站比赛——与其他32名探险爱好者一同踏上这段非凡旅程。参赛者将穿越不同时区和气候带，在七天内于七大洲完成七场马拉松。

journey.sentenceEn: M: So overall, was the journey unsuccessful?
journey.translationZh: 那么总体来说，这次考察算是失败了吗？
journey.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第15段，第1句

journey.sentenceEn: What does the woman think of the journey ?
journey.translationZh: 这位女士如何看待这次旅程？

jam.sentenceEn: It serves as a viable alternative to other forms of transport and has gone a long way to alleviate traffic jams in the city centre.
jam.translationZh: 它已成为其他交通方式的可行替代方案，并在缓解市中心交通拥堵方面发挥了重要作用。
jam.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第5句

jam.sentenceEn: Sitting in a more comfortable car in a different traffic jam is pleasant but hardly the liberation that once seemed to be promised.
jam.translationZh: 坐在一辆更舒适的车里遭遇另一场交通堵塞，或许能带来些许愉悦，但这绝不是曾经承诺的那种自由解放。
jam.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第4段，第3句

jam.sentenceEn: But when everyone has perfect information, traffic jams simply spread onto the side roads that seem to offer a way round them.
jam.translationZh: 但是当所有人都掌握了完美信息时，交通拥堵便会蔓延到那些本可以提供绕行路线的小路上。
jam.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第3段，第4句

jam.sentenceEn: Traffic jams often appear where no one has enough information to avoid them.
jam.translationZh: 交通拥堵往往出现在无人掌握足够信息以避开它们的地方。
jam.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第3段，第2句

jam.sentenceEn: For all the fuss made about top speeds, cornering ability and acceleration, the most useful gadgets on a modern car are those which work when you're going very slowly: parking sensors, sound systems, and navigation apps which will show a way around upcoming traffic jams .
jam.translationZh: 尽管人们对汽车的最高速度、转弯性能和加速能力大肆吹嘘，但现代汽车上最有用的装置却是那些在车速很慢时派上用场的设备：泊车传感器、音响系统，以及能指引绕过前方交通拥堵的导航应用。
jam.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第1句

jam.sentenceEn: It helps reduce traffic jams in the city centre.
jam.translationZh: 它在很大程度上缓解了市中心的交通拥堵。

justice.sentenceEn: Unlike Deep Springs, Sterling focuses its curriculum on environmental and social justice issues, but like Deep Springs it places a high value on personal responsibility and manual labor.
justice.translationZh: 与深泉学院不同，斯特林学院的课程设置侧重于环境和社会正义问题，但与深泉学院一样，它高度重视个人责任和体力劳动。

justice.sentenceEn: This discrepancy between state and private education is a matter of social justice .
justice.translationZh: 公立教育与私立教育之间的这种差异关乎社会公平。
justice.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第5段，第1句

justice.sentenceEn: So while there may be insights to be gained from matching behavior to brain activity, those insights will not necessarily lead to justice in a court of law.
justice.translationZh: 因此，虽然通过将行为与大脑活动进行匹配可能会获得一些洞见，但这些洞见未必能在法庭上带来公正的裁决。
justice.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第5段，第4句

justice.sentenceEn: It's particularly striking centuries later when these issues are still prominent in public discussions about social justice and women's rights.
justice.translationZh: 几个世纪后的今天，这些问题在关于社会正义和妇女权利的公开讨论中依然突出，这一点尤其引人注目。

justice.sentenceEn: In contrast, the criminal justice system accounted for nearly one out of every five visual backgrounds.
justice.translationZh: 相比之下，刑事司法系统几乎占据了五分之一的画面背景。

justice.sentenceEn: Justice has become so expensive that only a small number of people like corporate executives can afford it.
justice.translationZh: 司法公正已成为一种昂贵的商品，只有少数人负担得起。

joint.sentenceEn: But they can write prescriptions, diagnose common ailments—including digestive issues, joint pain, skin diseases, fever and the common cold—and refer patients to doctors at local hospitals.
joint.translationZh: 但他们可以开具处方，诊断常见疾病——包括消化问题、关节疼痛、皮肤病、发烧和普通感冒——并将患者转诊至当地医院的医生。

joint.sentenceEn: It's not clear whether Myers has experienced a stroke or other brain damage, but she also has a separate medical condition, which can result in loose joints , easily bruised skin and other problems.
joint.translationZh: 目前尚不清楚迈尔斯是否曾经历过中风或其他脑损伤，但她确实患有另一种独立的 medical condition，这种病症会导致关节松动、皮肤易瘀青以及其他问题。
joint.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第6句

joint.sentenceEn: The interracial roommates spent less time together, and had fewer joint activities than the white pairs.
joint.translationZh: 跨种族室友在一起的时间更少，共同参与的活动也比白人室友少。
joint.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第3段，第2句

joint.sentenceEn: Potential problems related to data sharing should be made known to and discussed by all participants at the beginning of a joint research project.
joint.translationZh: 在联合研究项目开始时，所有参与者都应了解并讨论与数据共享相关的潜在问题。

joint.sentenceEn: Make joint efforts to tackle the nation's equity issues.
joint.translationZh: 共同努力解决国家的公平问题。

junior.sentenceEn: About four years later, members of the Junior Ladies Garden Club (who'd tended to the tree before its unfortunate death) tracked down a small tree grown from a nut taken from the original tree.
junior.translationZh: 大约四年后，少年女子园艺俱乐部的成员们（在那棵树不幸死亡前一直照料它）找到了一棵小树，这棵小树是用从原树上取下的一颗坚果培育而成的。

junior.sentenceEn: Yet this study showed that even the junior roles in psychology journals tended to be held disproportionately by men, despite the fact that there are actually more female than male junior psychology faculty.
junior.translationZh: 然而这项研究表明，即使是心理学期刊的初级编辑职位，男性也往往占比过高，尽管实际上初级心理学教师中女性多于男性。
junior.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第6段，第2句

junior.sentenceEn: After the blaze was declared completely extinguished, 15 hours after it started, the junior interior minister, Laurent Nunez, said the structure had been saved but remained vulnerable.
junior.translationZh: 在大火开始15小时后被宣布完全扑灭后，法国内政部副部长洛朗·努涅斯表示，建筑主体已被挽救，但仍处于脆弱状态。

junior.sentenceEn: As a high school junior , everything in my life revolved around getting into the right college.
junior.translationZh: 作为一名高二学生，我生活中的一切都围绕着进入理想的大学。

junior.sentenceEn: As more journal and funders adopt data-sharing requirements, and as a growing number of enthusiasts call for more openness, junior researchers must find their place between adopters and those who continue to hold out, even as they strive to launch their own careers.
junior.translationZh: 随着越来越多的期刊和资助机构开始采纳数据共享要求，同时越来越多的热心人士呼吁提高开放度，青年研究人员必须在数据共享的采纳者和坚持不共享的人之间找到自己的位置，同时还要努力开创自己的职业生涯。

junior.sentenceEn: Junior researchers may have no say when it comes to sharing data.
junior.translationZh: 在数据共享方面，初级研究人员可能没有发言权。

junk.sentenceEn: If you're someone who has turned to snacking on junk food more in the pandemic(大流行病), you're not alone.
junk.translationZh: 如果你是在疫情期间更多地转向吃垃圾食品零食的人，那么你并不孤单。
junk.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第1句

junk.sentenceEn: The greatest concern the authors raise is space debris—pieces of " junk " that orbit the earth, with the potential to cause serious damage if they collide with operational units, including the ISS.
junk.translationZh: 报告作者提出的最大担忧是太空碎片——即环绕地球运行的“垃圾”碎片，一旦与包括国际空间站（ISS）在内的运行设备发生碰撞，就有可能造成严重损坏。

junk.sentenceEn: I don't know about yours, but mine are all about junk food.
junk.translationZh: 不知道你的孩子怎么样，反正我的孩子们满脑子都是垃圾食品。
junk.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第3段，第5句

junk.sentenceEn: What is it with kids these days and all that junk food they eat?
junk.translationZh: 现在的孩子们到底是怎么回事，老是吃那些垃圾食品？
junk.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第4段，第4句

junk.sentenceEn: Some children on the remote islands won't eat their meals because they are fed cheap junk food.
junk.translationZh: 偏远岛屿上的一些儿童不愿吃饭，因为他们被喂了廉价的垃圾食品。
他们几乎没有什么垃圾食品。
